description: Planning checklist only. This is not an API import, router configuration, provisioning manifest, purchase order, spectrum permission or evidence of installed hardware.

site.note: Two hours is a proposed engineering target. Confirm the location, measured load, local approvals and budget before selecting equipment.

phases.purpose: Inventory, isolated local network and synthetic application acceptance using existing authorized internet.
Authorized host SIM/eSIM, terrestrial functions and provider integration acceptance.
Authorized Zimbabwe handset-to-satellite acceptance for explicitly entitled services and devices.
Separate Starlink terminal IP/Wi-Fi path test; never evidence of handset direct-to-cell service.

assets.selection: Reuse first; encrypted supported workstation. Local iOS compilation requires a Mac compatible with the selected stable Xcode. Suggested sizing: 16 GB RAM and 512 GB SSD.
Reference candidate, not an approved purchase. Verify local approval, supported firmware, firewall/VLAN behavior, recovery and measured capacity. Passive PoE is not universal AP power.
Qualified managed Wi-Fi AP with separate management/test/visitor networks and compatible approved power supply. Optional for a wired-only initial bench.
Borrow/reuse an unlocked supported iPhone. Record exact regional SKU, iOS and carrier settings. Host acceptance for radio tests remains unverified.
Representative mainstream supported Android phone; qualify exact SKU, firmware and host SIM/eSIM configuration later.
Lower-cost phone representative of pilot customers, within app OS support, for accessibility/resource/offline acceptance. No satellite compatibility assumed.
Borrow/share one supported iPad or Android tablet; extend matrix according to actual pilot devices.
Select after measuring network load, startup and target runtime; confirm compatible supplies and controlled restart. No capacity or VA rating selected yet.
One kit: six labelled Cat6 leads, appropriate workstation Ethernet adapter, phone USB cables and local console cable if supported.
Encrypted removable configuration/lab backup medium with separate recovery-key custody; no real subscriber records until hosting and retention controls are accepted.
Compatible manufacturer-approved phone charging supplies; useful for later authorized field trials.
Host-approved test SIMs for active, inactive, replacement and negative-test cases. SIM identifiers and secrets belong outside this repository.
No terminal selected. Consider one only after a separate IP-path requirement, Zimbabwe terms/permission, equipment approval, kit/wiring and installation assessment. This is not direct-to-cell.

conditionalEntitlements.note: No profiles issued. Actual activation secrets must never be stored in this file.
Host must specify interface, security, addressing and any additional equipment.
No Zimbabwe host, Onesa wholesale access, handset list or supported functions have been established.

gates.note: Must cover controller/DPO, subscriber-data location, foreign hosting conditions, local key custody, consent, backups and recovery.

acceptanceTests.name: Management isolation across IPv4 and IPv6
Measured backup runtime and controlled restart
Native application install and device acceptance
Exact eligibility and evidenced satellite attachment
Each contracted satellite function and recovery
Approved emergency responsibility and test facility

trialRecordingRules.instructions: Retain approved device/network evidence for real observations. A simulator, UI label, completed form or dish connection does not demonstrate D2C attachment. The operations software records observations and never configures or transmits RF.

exclusions: No assumed PamoFi inventory or reuse approval
No local cellular base station or mobile core purchase in this Light MVNO bench plan
No inferred carrier partnership, spectrum allocation, Zimbabwe satellite coverage or Starlink API
No verified supplier quotation or retail tariff
No subscriber identifiers, credentials, actual private site location or device secrets
